repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Claim: PM loop · 2026-11-22T02:32Z · #36005 (p1): the showcase invoice's line items and subtotal follow the invoice's currency. The cause is in the example, not the console. The platform's "lines follow the parent record's currency" (ADR-0144 amendment, #31910–#31912) is already wired. The showcase invoice lines (`unit_price`, `amount`) and subtotal (`total`) never declared it, so they fell back to the base currency (USD, `$`). The same cause and fix cover the record page's read-only line table.
Area: b1-R2 (not under an epic; maintainer 「这些全部接，能派的立刻派」 2026-11-22T02:27Z)

Small call (thread decides, listed in the PR body): once the example declares it, a showcase invoice with lines locks its currency, and an invoice without a currency cannot save money lines. That is the already-ruled platform rule taking effect on the example, not a platform behaviour change. The showcase is private, so no changeset.
